purpose: Require every diagnostic projection to be reproducible, versioned, frozen, visible, and non-actionable.

probability_semantics.model_p: Independent deterministic point-estimate win probability from the registered engine.
probability_semantics.sim_p: Fraction of seeded Monte Carlo paths won. If no actual simulation was executed, the field must be null and may not be labeled Sim P.
probability_semantics.conservative_p: Optional calibrated/compressed probability; must be null unless a validated calibration layer is registered.
probability_semantics.sim_gap: abs(model_p - sim_p); diagnostic only and never averaged away.

publication_invariant.success_rule: No rendered model card means no successful forecast run.
